note: MERRA-2's land model computes evaporation from the water it holds in the soil, and is driven by observation-corrected precipitation: this link is partly the model's own land physics
text: Precipitation (Central Sahel) comes first: 1 month after it leaves its norm, Root-zone soil wetness (Central Sahel) leaves its own the same way: 44 times, where chance at the same moment of the record would give 23 (p = 2e-05; z = 5.0 against the same reading with one of them moved 1 to 5 years, beyond the shared trend and the persistence of each).
